logo_alt: Vilna logo: a swallow flying out of a brushstroke circle
gloxi_desc: Gloxi is an AI assistant for GNOME that runs on your own computer and acts only with your permission. A preview for testers.
gloxi_lead: An AI assistant for GNOME that talks to a model on your own computer and acts only with your permission.
gloxi_local_p: A small language model runs on your computer. Without the cloud, nothing you write leaves it.
gloxi_cloud_p: You can connect any OpenAI-compatible service with your own key. Personal data is masked before it leaves your computer.
gloxi_asks_p: Gloxi works only in the folders you choose, and only through Herkos, which shows what will change, asks you and keeps a log.
gloxi_warn_h: An honest word about the preview
gloxi_warn_p: This is an early version for testing. On a regular Linux, Herkos runs in the same sandbox as Gloxi, so the protection is weaker than it will be in Vilna OS, where Herkos is a separate system service. Do not give Gloxi folders you cannot afford to lose, and keep backups.
gloxi_need_os: Linux with GNOME and Flatpak (openSUSE Aeon, Fedora Workstation, Ubuntu with Flatpak and so on).
gloxi_need_cpu: A 64-bit Intel or AMD processor; a graphics card is optional.
gloxi_need_ram: At least 8 GB of RAM, 16 GB is better; about 3 GB of free space for the model.
gloxi_install_soon: Gloxi 0.1 comes out at the end of January 2027. Until then you can build it from source.
gloxi_step_download: Download gloxi.flatpak and gloxi.flatpak.sha256 from the latest release:
gloxi_step_verify: Check that the file is complete and has not been replaced:
gloxi_step_install: Install the GNOME runtime from Flathub (if you do not have it yet) and Gloxi itself:
gloxi_step_run: Start Gloxi from the app menu or with flatpak run io.github.stdenis1980.Gloxi. On the first start Gloxi asks before it downloads the model (Qwen3 4B, about 2.5 GB) and checks its checksum. Nothing about you is sent.
gloxi_remove: To remove it: flatpak uninstall --user io.github.stdenis1980.Gloxi (add --delete-data to erase the model and settings too).
gloxi_feedback_p: We most want to know what worked, what did not, and where Gloxi surprised you. Please mention your distribution, how much memory you have and what you asked.
gloxi_feedback_public: Feedback is public. Do not paste personal data, passwords or the contents of your files. Report vulnerabilities privately — see security.txt.
gloxi_footer: Gloxi is part of Vilna OS
privacy_desc: What the Vilna OS site sees, what GitHub sees when you download, and what Gloxi does with your data.
privacy_lead: In short: this site collects nothing about you, and by default Gloxi sends nothing from your computer.
privacy_site_1: No cookies, analytics, counters, ads, embedded videos or social buttons.
privacy_site_2: All fonts, icons and styles are served by this site; your browser does not contact other servers.
privacy_site_3: The site is hosted in Europe. The host briefly sees the technical details of each request (as every web server does) but does not keep your IP address in its logs.
privacy_github_p: Gloxi's files and code are on GitHub. When you go there or download a release, the GitHub privacy statement applies. Feedback in GitHub Issues is public.
privacy_gloxi_1: By default Gloxi uses a model on your computer, and your conversations do not leave it.
privacy_gloxi_2: The model is downloaded only after you agree; only the request for the file is sent.
privacy_gloxi_3: You turn the cloud on yourself, with your own key for a service you choose. Personal data is masked on the device before it is sent. What that service does with the masked text is up to its own policy.
privacy_gloxi_4: Gloxi sends us no statistics and no crash reports.
privacy_contact_p: Privacy questions: GitHub Issues; vulnerabilities: privately, see security.txt.

blavet_desc: Blavet is the name of the first Vilna release: a cornflower and a kingfisher.
blavet_lead: The first release of Vilna is called Blavet. In Valencian the word means both the cornflower and the kingfisher, a small blue bird with an orange breast.
blavet_mark_alt: The Blavet mark: a kingfisher looking out of a hollow
blavet_name_p: Vilna releases are named after flowers. The cornflower and the kingfisher share the colours of Vilna: blue, orange and gold. Every release has its own mark, while the Vilna logo and the Gloxi owl stay the same.
blavet_look_p: The light style is the default, with the Sun wallpaper; the dark style is one switch away. The Blavet wallpaper turns the wing of the kingfisher into a Petrykivka ornament.
blavet_in_gloxi: The assistant that runs a language model on your own computer and acts only with your permission.
blavet_in_herkos: The guard between Gloxi and your system: it shows what will change, asks you and keeps a log.
blavet_in_updates: Based on openSUSE Aeon: the system updates itself in the background, and every update can be rolled back.
blavet_when_p: Blavet is in development. The alpha is planned by March 2028. You can follow the work in the open code.
